empirical_windows_behavior: Validates compressed input IMFMediaType (MFMediaType_Video with MFVideoFormat_H264 or MFVideoFormat_HEVC, frame dimensions, and MF_MT_MPEG_SEQUENCE_HEADER SPS/PPS/VPS parameter sets) and uncompressed output IMFMediaType (MFVideoFormat_NV12 or MFVideoFormat_P010).
Decodes Annex-B or length-prefixed AVCC/HVCC NAL access units into contiguous NV12 (Y plane + interleaved UV plane) or P010 output IMFMediaBuffer instances.
macos_backend_strategy: Use Apple VideoToolbox & CoreMedia (VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported, CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreateFromH264ParameterSets, CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreateFromHEVCParameterSets, VTDecompressionSessionCreate, CMSampleBufferCreateReady, VTDecompressionSessionDecodeFrame, CVPixelBufferLockBaseAddress) with deterministic NV12/P010 reconstruction.
